nom: Good Molecules Rich Cream with Ceramides

segments.oily: Reports split: several oily-skin users say the cream absorbs well, controls shine, and even reduces oiliness compared to their old moisturizer, while others (including a 2-star review) find it too heavy, greasy, or pore-clogging for oily skin.
segments.dry: Widely praised by dry-skin reviewers, including those in cold or dry climates, for resolving flaky patches, dry lip-area peeling, and all-day dryness, though one dry-skin user notes it feels oily by midday.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe balanced hydration without excess shine on the T-zone and no new breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Mixed: many sensitive-skin reviewers say it's finally a moisturizer that doesn't irritate them, but a large cluster of one-star reviews (some explicitly sensitive, some not previously so) describe itchy bumps, rashes, or swelling after only one to three uses.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (including a 64-year-old) report good moisturizing effect and skin barrier support, with one calling it rich enough for oily-leaning mature skin.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer in a dry climate says it provides the intensive moisture her skin needed; no negative aging-specific reports.
concerns.dehydration: The majority of reviewers citing dryness or dehydration report strong, lasting hydration and relief from flaky or peeling patches, though one reviewer felt hydrated at first but dry again an hour later.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness or calmer rosacea-related redness over weeks of use, but many one-star reviews describe new red, itchy bumps or a rash appearing after a few uses.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers credit the cream with repairing or strengthening a damaged skin barrier and reducing associated redness and inflammation; one reviewer using it specifically for barrier repair instead had swelling and red bumps.
concerns.spots: Not clearly distinguished from general breakout complaints in these reviews.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers, some also with rosacea, report no new breakouts and calmer skin over a month; against this, numerous one-star reviews describe sudden tiny-bump breakouts, cystic-feeling texture, or rash-like flare-ups within two to three days of first use.
concerns.oiliness: Some oily-skin reviewers say it reduces shine or doesn't add oiliness despite the rich texture, while others explicitly say it's too oily or heavy for oily skin and increases midday shine.

aspects.libelle: Sudden tiny-bump breakout after a few uses
Sits well under makeup, no pilling
Small tube size for the price
Absorbs quickly leaving a light glow

extraits.texte: I have consistently used Good Molecules products for years and they are usually amazing for my skin. This made me feel confident that I could ignore the negative reviews and give this a chance. Wrong! I used it for the first time earlier this week, and after the second use, I woke up to find my forehead and neck completely covered in tiny bumps. Four days later, they are fading but now I have itchy, flaky, dry spots where the bumps were. I do have acne-prone skin, but this type of reaction has never happened to me with any product in my life. Please don't buy this!

tried this because so far ive loved the brand and needed a new moisturizer. First, i know it says its rich, but its lowkey and understatement lol. This cream is very very thick to me, little goes a long way but at the same time it almost feels uncomfortable to not cake on? if its too thin its not as spreadable. But if you put too much ive noticed it start to crumble and almost like pilling on my face and i have to rub it off my face so i dont have white crumbs on my face, looking dirty. Second, I have pretty oily skin and know thicker creams arent the best but again love the brand so far so said f it why not, but this is really not for oily skin as it only enhances it. and if youre putting this on in a hot bathroom, god bless.

I'm not being dramatic when I say this moisturizer changed my skin in the best way. My skin is extremely acne prone and I rosacea. Seriously 90% of skincare products break me out. I've been using this mousturizer for over a month and have not had ANY new breakouts. My skin is soft and even toned. The redness is under control. I hope this never goes away and that they make a bigger bottle.

I have very sensitive skin but had no issues with this product. I do not doubt others may have but it works great for me. I always do a test spot and had no reaction. Usually if i do react it is not the product itself but it is a combination of products. Some peole may be sensitive to the ceramides; it might help to use it only a few times per week vs every day (I have to be very careful with Vitamin C products that other people have no issue using). I would def recommend but would advise to try a test area prior to using all over.

I've always had dry/combo skin and have a damaged skin barrier. I live in Utah where the cold and dry weather can be SO HARSH. This product I've been able to continuously use and it takes the redness away, leaves my skin feeling hydrated, looking plump and even gives me a little bit of a glow! I'm always getting compliments from other girls! :) Would def reccomend to other girls and guys who struggle with those things as well. I feel like because it's helped repair my skin barrier it has also helped tone down the acne, inflammation and redness that comes with it!

I have dry skin and I live in a very dry area so I'm always looking for a moisturizer that I only need to apply once. I like how thick and creamy the formula is. It makes my skin feel soft and protected. The only thing I'm not a huge fan of is it makes me feel oily mid way through the day. Gifted by Good Molecules
This gives just the right amount of moisture and soothing to my mature sensitive skin. I'll definitely repurchase!
